_note: Names for the texture files, read by both editions: other spellings of a picture's file, pictures that borrow another's file until they have their own, and the names of font letters a file name can't hold.

_notes.TEXTURE_SPELLINGS: a file named like this (the key) is that picture (the value): old or misspelt file names that still work
_notes.TEXTURE_BORROWS: a picture with no file of its own (the key) uses this one's (the value; that one may borrow too). Once the picture has its own file, that's used
_notes.FONT_NAMES: a letter picture in textures/font/ named like this (the key) is this character (the value). A file named with one character (a.png, 7.png) is just that character; in the upper folder, the capital
